newsitem.title: USA: Adelphia offers long distance through IXC.
newsitem.headline: Adelphia offers long distance through IXC.

text.p: IXC Communications Inc said Wednesday it will provide cable television company Adelphia Telecommunications Inc with the capability to offer long distance telephone services.

Pennsylvania-based Adelphia is a subsidiary of Adelphia Communications, which owns, operates and manages cable television systems in 11 states, including Florida, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania and Virginia.
IXC did not disclose financial details but noted that the agreement was a three-year, "multimillion-dollar" deal.
IXC said that in addition to long distance service, it will offer calling cards and debit cards.
